correctness.rationale: The 945 Zumkeller witness {945,3,5,7} and coprime-product lemma prove 945+99225t Zumkeller for all t>=0. Complete Stewart-Sierpiński residue enumeration yields all 99225 practical residue representatives with maximum 41235272, proving unconditional coverage for n>=41236217. For the finite region, every even n>=90 is covered by the primary literature construction, and a checked exact C++ bitset convolution covers every odd n from 19069 through 41236216 except 20177, itself 20176+1. Separate exact Python divisor-subset enumeration proves no representation of 19067, and counts 720 gaps through 19067. Both verifiers were actually executed successfully; their checks exhaust specified finite ranges and are coupled with the infinite arithmetic argument.

value.rationale: The exact least conductor of Z+P answers a natural quantitative gap left by the published qualitative co-finiteness theorem. The maximal nonrepresentable integer 19067 and the complete 720-exception set are structurally motivated by that theorem, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The new 99225 arithmetic residue cover transforms a finite search into an unbounded proof and makes the sharp threshold independently reproducible.
